messages.subject: Booking a school visit in January
messages.bodyPreview: Hello, our sixth form art group would like to sketch in the galleries one afternoon in January. Is a Tuesday possible?

messages.subject: Donation of shipyard photographs
messages.bodyPreview: My late father was a plater at the east yard and left about forty photographs. Would the museum like to see them?

messages.subject: Room hire availability, April 2027
messages.bodyPreview: Could you hold Friday 23 April 2027 for our awards dinner while we arrange a viewing?

messages.subject: Lantern night: can our choir sing?
messages.bodyPreview: The Seaham Ladies' Choir would love to sing for twenty minutes at the late opening if there is space in the programme.

messages.subject: Accessibility of the lecture theatre
messages.bodyPreview: Is there a hearing loop in the lecture theatre for the talk on 15 December?

messages.subject: Lost umbrella
messages.bodyPreview: I left a black umbrella with a wooden handle by the cloakroom on Sunday. Has it been handed in?

messages.subject: Research enquiry: SS Brennock Head
messages.bodyPreview: I am building a model of the collier SS Brennock Head. Do you hold her general arrangement plans?

messages.subject: Volunteering at the museum
messages.bodyPreview: I have just retired from teaching and would like to volunteer, perhaps with school groups. How do I apply?

messages.subject: Gift membership vouchers
messages.bodyPreview: Can I buy two Friends memberships as gifts and have the cards posted to my sister in York?

messages.subject: Filming request: regional news
messages.bodyPreview: We would like to film a short piece on the rivet gang film in Salt and Iron next week. Who should I speak to?

messages.subject: Coach parking
messages.bodyPreview: Our walking club is coming by coach on 12 December. Where can the coach drop off and park?
